# Confirm (`confirm`)

Promise-based confirm with destructive and type-to-confirm modes.

Group: Overlays. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/overlays';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`confirm` (types in `dist/web/overlays/confirm.d.ts`): Asks a yes/no question in a modal `alertdialog` (`.mh-overlay.mh-dialog.mh-confirm`) and resolves `true` for the confirm button, `false` for Cancel, Escape or a scrim click.

```ts
export function confirm(options: ConfirmOptions): Promise<boolean>;

export interface ConfirmOptions {
  title: string;
  message?: string;
  /** Default "Confirm". */
  confirmLabel?: string;
  /** Default "Cancel". */
  cancelLabel?: string;
  /** A danger-toned confirm button; focus starts on Cancel. */
  destructive?: boolean;
  /** Type-to-confirm: the confirm button stays disabled until this exact text is typed. */
  requireText?: string;
  /** Label of the type-to-confirm field. Default `Type "<requireText>" to confirm`. */
  requireTextLabel?: string;
  container?: HTMLElement | null;
}
```

`createButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/button.d.ts`): `.mh-button` with `--primary | --secondary | --tonal | --text | --danger` and `--sm | --lg`; states `.is-loading` and `:disabled`. Height follows the theme's density, corners its control radius.

```ts
export function createButton(options: ButtonOptions): ButtonHandle;

export interface ButtonOptions {
  label: string;
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailingIcon?: IconName | string;
  loading?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset';
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface ButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setLabel(label: string): void;
  setLoading(loading: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`h` (types in `dist/web/dom.d.ts`): Creates an element: string and number attributes are set, `true` sets an empty attribute, `on*` functions become listeners.

```ts
export function h<K extends keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap>(tag: K, attrs: Attrs = {}, ...children: Child[]): HTMLElementTagNameMap[K];
```

## Web example

```ts
import { confirm, createButton, h } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const result = h('p', { 'aria-live': 'polite' });

const remove = createButton({
  label: 'Delete scene',
  icon: 'delete',
  variant: 'danger',
  onClick: async () => {
    const ok = await confirm({
      title: 'Delete "Evening"?',
      message: 'This cannot be undone.',
      confirmLabel: 'Delete',
      destructive: true,
    });
    result.textContent = ok ? 'Scene deleted' : 'Kept the scene';
  },
});

document.body.append(remove.el, result);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, confirm } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function ConfirmExample() {
  const [result, setResult] = useState('');
  const remove = async () => {
    const ok = await confirm({
      title: 'Delete "Evening"?',
      message: 'This cannot be undone.',
      confirmLabel: 'Delete',
      destructive: true,
    });
    setResult(ok ? 'Scene deleted' : 'Kept the scene');
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Button icon="delete" variant="danger" onClick={remove}>
        Delete scene
      </Button>
      <p aria-live="polite">{result}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```
